items.name: All-or-nothing
items.definition: Seeing things in only two categories, with nothing in between.
items.example: If this isn't perfect, it's a total failure.

items.name: Overgeneralising
items.definition: Treating one event as a never-ending pattern.
items.example: Ye hamesha mere saath hi hota hai.

items.name: Mental filter
items.definition: Focusing on one negative detail and filtering out the rest.
items.example: The whole day was ruined because of one comment.

items.name: Discounting the positive
items.definition: Deciding that good things don't count.
items.example: They only said it was good to be polite.

items.name: Mind reading
items.definition: Assuming you know what others are thinking, usually something negative.
items.example: She didn't reply, so she must be upset with me.

items.name: Fortune telling
items.definition: Predicting that things will turn out badly, as if it were certain.
items.example: I'll definitely mess up the interview.

items.name: Catastrophising
items.definition: Jumping to the worst possible outcome.
items.example: If I miss this deadline, my whole career is over.

items.name: Magnifying and minimising
items.definition: Blowing up mistakes and shrinking strengths.
items.example: My one error matters more than everything I got right.

items.name: Emotional reasoning
items.definition: Believing something is true because it feels true.
items.example: I feel useless, so I must be useless.

items.name: Should statements
items.definition: Rigid rules about how you or others must behave.
items.example: Mujhe ab tak sab kuch samajh aa jana chahiye tha.

items.name: Labelling
items.definition: Attaching a harsh label to yourself or others after one event.
items.example: I forgot her birthday — I'm a terrible friend.

items.name: Personalising
items.definition: Taking responsibility for things that aren't fully in your control.
items.example: The party was boring because of me.

items.name: Blaming
items.definition: Holding others entirely responsible for how you feel.
items.example: It's all their fault that I'm like this.

items.name: Unfair comparisons
items.definition: Measuring yourself against others in ways that leave you short.
items.example: Everyone my age is married and settled except me.

items.name: What-if thinking
items.definition: A chain of 'what if' questions that never feels answered.
items.example: What if they say no? What if I embarrass myself?
